DemoData._comment: SeedSampleCatalog: set true to add 2 demo products (DEMO-0001/0002) with stocked variants on next run, purely for testing checkout/fulfillment end to end. Development-only - has no effect outside the Development environment. Turn back off (or just delete the demo products via Product Management) once you're done.

CourierGuy._comment: Provider: "Fake" uses a free, instant, in-process courier double (FakeCourierService) instead of the real (billed) Courier Guy sandbox - see Program.cs. "EasyPost" uses a REAL API call against EasyPost's free test mode instead. Only "Fake"/"EasyPost" are honoured in Development. Switch to "Live" for a final, deliberately limited pass against the real sandbox before going live - that one does cost real sandbox balance per action.

EasyPost._comment: Only used when CourierGuy:Provider is "EasyPost" above. Get a free test key (starts with EZTK) from https://www.easypost.com after signing up - no card required, test keys never charge. Set the real value via user-secrets, not here: dotnet user-secrets set "EasyPost:ApiKey" "EZTK..."
